servinfo.title: Accelerator Pedal Assembly (Incorporating APP Sensor) Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when handling the APP sensor assembly may lead to malfunction of the APP sensor.

item.ptxt: Do not drop or otherwise expose the APP sensor assembly to large shock. Any APP sensor assembly that has received large shock must be replaced.
Keep the sensor section of the APP sensor assembly away from water.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect connector from accelerator pedal assembly (incorporating APP sensor) (1).

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following point.

item.ptxt: Tighten accelerator pedal assembly nuts (2) to specified torque.
